sahneler.istem: Character reference: Yuru (the serious man with glasses, grey temples and a flat mouth) wearing a white ship captain's cap with a gold anchor, standing on the deck at the foot of the tall ship's mast, calm blue ocean behind him. He cups both hands around his mouth and shouts loudly upward toward the crow's nest high above, head tilted far back, then lowers his hands, folds his arms and waits deadpan, looks at his wristwatch, taps his foot, sighs. A seagull lands on the railing. Static medium-wide shot. No speech, no text, no subtitles, no music.

Character reference: Hadi (the cheerful round-faced man with a black mustache) in a small crow's nest at the top of a ship mast, in a sailor's striped shirt, fast asleep on a pile of simit with binoculars hanging from his neck. He suddenly jerks awake in panic, grabs the binoculars upside down, looks, then jumps up with both arms in the air shouting in excitement with a wide open mouth. The sea behind him with a tiny strip of land far away. Comedic, energetic, quick motion. No speech, no text, no subtitles, no music.

Character reference: Yuru (the serious man with glasses, grey temples, black mustache and a flat mouth) wearing a white ship captain's cap with a gold anchor and a white captain's uniform with gold epaulettes, alone at the wheel on the bridge of a small cargo ship. In the big window behind him the ship has already run gently onto a sandy beach full of beach umbrellas and astonished tourists. He slowly turns his head toward the camera with a deadpan stare, gives a long weary sigh, then rolls his eyes up toward the ceiling as if looking at the mast above. Only this one character in the frame, his face, glasses, mustache, cap and uniform stay exactly the same throughout. Static medium shot. No speech, no text, no subtitles, no music.
